name: One-beat hush, decisive proof
signature: Hold full black for a perceptible hush; hard-cut directly to the completed proof image; keep the proof still long enough to register before the exit.

name: Practical light discovers the proof
signature: Begin inside a genuinely dark live shot; a practical light rises around the subject, revealing silhouette, surface, then the complete proof without changing framing.

name: Interrupted fragment to undeniable result
signature: Show a brief incomplete process fragment; interrupt it with a short blackout; land on the finished result exactly when the key voice clause resolves.

name: Exposure recovery from near-black
signature: Open on an underexposed proof shot rather than a graphic card; recover exposure from the focal subject outward; stop the lift at a natural image level and hold.

name: Subject crosses out of the void
signature: Let the hero subject enter from a black occluding foreground; its movement uncovers the proof environment behind it; settle on the revealed relationship.

name: Voice names it before we see it
signature: Keep the frame black while the incoming line begins; cut to proof on the operative noun; let the incoming ambience continue under the held image.

name: Proof flash with earned return to black
signature: Flash two incomplete evidence glimpses, each revealing a different property; hold the third complete proof; cut back to black only after the consequence is understood.

name: Eyeline to horizon
signature: Establish an observer in profile; let the eyes settle off-screen; cut to the world with the horizon or subject placed on that gaze point; hold the destination.

name: Silhouette becomes scale reference
signature: Hold a human silhouette against a partial view; pull or reveal past the silhouette until the full environment dominates while the person remains as a scale anchor.

name: Gesture hands off to aerial route
signature: Show a hand or head gesture traveling in one screen direction; cut on peak motion to an aerial move continuing that vector; settle at the indicated location.

name: Reflection opens into the real world
signature: Frame the destination first as a reflection in an eye, visor, or window; move toward the reflected image; cross the reflective plane into the full environment.

name: Footfall to terrain
signature: Cut from a witnessed footfall or hand contact to a terrain feature with matching position and direction; let the wide shot reveal where that action belongs.

name: Passing body reveals the world
signature: Track a witness moving across the lens; hide the cut at maximum body occlusion; continue the motion as the body clears into the destination environment.

name: Ambience pulls the gaze outward
signature: Begin on a quiet observer; introduce destination ambience before the picture changes; let the observer react; cut to the matching wide source of that sound.

name: Matched-frame anomaly
signature: Establish the expected state; hard-cut to an anomalous state with the main object held at the same position and scale; hold the single changed feature.

name: Claim then visible counterexample
signature: Present a short central claim over its supporting baseline; remove the claim; reveal one counterexample in the same visual field and hold it unanswered.

name: Expected motion reverses
signature: Let a familiar action begin normally; freeze at the predicted outcome; resume with the critical element moving in the opposite or impossible direction.

name: Normal pattern, one exception
signature: Build a repeated set in a stable composition; complete several expected states; isolate the one exception only after the viewer has learned the pattern.

name: Off-screen cue exposes the contradiction
signature: Hold a normal-looking scene; introduce an incompatible sound from outside the focus plane; rack or pan once to reveal its visible cause.

name: False scale collapses
signature: Begin on a detail that implies one scale; pull or cut wide while preserving the detail anchor; let the unexpected surrounding scale become the question.

name: Outcome precedes the presumed cause
signature: Open on the surprising result; cut back to the familiar setup on a matching object; stop before the missing causal step, leaving the gap explicit.

name: Wide-medium-detail promise
signature: Cut wide context to medium action to decisive detail; shorten the first two holds; keep the detail long enough to establish the promised payoff.

name: Three outcomes, rising stakes
signature: Reveal three finished outcomes in increasing consequence rather than visual size; punctuate only the final outcome; finish on the one the story will explain.

name: Process fragments in causal order
signature: Show trigger, operation, and visible result as separate proof fragments; preserve motion direction between cuts; hold the result after the chain completes.

name: Human, artifact, consequence
signature: Cut from a human reaction to the responsible artifact and then to its environmental consequence; use the reaction eyeline to place the artifact.

name: Shape-linked proof chain
signature: Match a dominant shape across three otherwise different proof shots; let the final match break scale and reveal the larger subject.

name: Sound-led corroboration triplet
signature: Preview each next proof with its native sound; cut picture on the sound identity; release the music bed only when the third proof verifies the promise.

name: Many clues converge on one proof
signature: Flash four distinct clues in separate full-frame cuts; recompose them as four spatial fragments; collapse those fragments into one complete hero result.

name: Clause-built central title
signature: Reveal the first meaningful title clause at center; add the second clause beneath only after the first is read; hold the complete hierarchy without further motion.

name: Soft image, sharp title, resolved world
signature: Start with the background optically soft; bring the central title into focus; after it is read, resolve the image behind it while the title remains stable.

name: Keyword grows into the full thought
signature: Begin with one central operative word; make room by moving it to its final line position; reveal the rest of the title around it and settle.

name: Subject passes behind the title
signature: Establish the title in the subject plane; allow a foreground subject to pass in front through a clean matte; reveal the full environment after the pass.

name: Title follows a real object contour
signature: Reveal a title beside a meaningful object edge; move the camera once along that edge; complete the title exactly where the object relationship becomes clear.

name: Semantic two-line hinge
signature: Show a stable first line; pivot the meaning by replacing only one word in the second line; hold the completed contrast as a single centered title.

name: Localized light uncovers the title
signature: Keep a negative field visible; raise one soft pool of light behind the title area; reveal the full title inside that pool and let the light stop moving.

name: Title assembled through depth planes
signature: Place separate title clauses on foreground, middle, and background planes; travel through them in reading order; align all clauses into one flat final lockup.

name: Centered portrait window settle
signature: Open on a clean landscape field; reveal one centered portrait window at readable scale; let the portrait action play while the outside field stays quiet.

name: Still frame wakes into portrait motion
signature: Present the portrait source as a held still; start its internal motion on a semantic audio cue; add depth separation only after movement begins.

name: Landscape compresses into portrait portal
signature: Begin with the source covering the landscape canvas; protect the focal subject as the image narrows into a portrait window; reveal the contextual field around it.

name: Foreground crosses the portrait stage
signature: Set the portrait window behind a real or matted foreground subject; move the foreground across once; use the occlusion to replace the portal content.

name: Focus trades between two portrait moments
signature: Hold a primary portrait window; introduce a smaller second moment behind it; transfer focus and scale once so the second becomes primary while the first recedes.

name: Diegetic screen becomes the destination
signature: Start with portrait footage playing on a screen inside a wider world; approach the screen along its normal; cross its surface into the footage.

name: Tilted portal corrects to attention
signature: Introduce the portrait plane with a modest perspective tilt; rotate it square only as the focal action begins; hold it front-facing for comprehension.

name: Portrait subject escapes the matte
signature: Keep the environment inside the portrait window; let one cleanly matted subject cross beyond its edge; expand the destination after the breakout.

name: Number then chapter phrase
signature: Land one large central numeral; reveal the short chapter phrase beside or beneath it; hold both as one hierarchy and exit cleanly.

name: Phrase first, numeral confirms
signature: Show the chapter phrase alone; introduce its ordinal only after the phrase is read; keep the ordinal semantically subordinate.

name: Freeze, chapter, resume
signature: Freeze the underlying action at a meaningful threshold; lower its contrast; reveal the central chapter statement; remove it and resume the same action.

name: Numeral reveals footage through its counter
signature: Place a large serif numeral at center; use its enclosed counter or silhouette as a genuine footage aperture; expand from that aperture into the chapter scene.

name: Two-part chapter statement locks
signature: Reveal the topic word; introduce the action word from the focal subject direction; snap both into one readable phrase and hold.

name: Incoming line carries the card
signature: Let the next voice line begin over the outgoing picture; cut to the clean chapter statement on its first key word; keep voice continuity through the exit.

name: Chapter appears on a lit surface
signature: Approach a real surface or object face; light reaches it; reveal the chapter phrase as part of that plane; settle before cutting away.

name: Impact word expands to explanatory phrase
signature: Strike one central chapter word; after the hit decays, add a short explanatory phrase without moving the impact word; hold the complete thought.

name: Action completes across the cut
signature: Begin a clear physical action in asset A; cut at peak velocity; complete the same action vector in asset B; hold the consequence.

name: Claim clause meets proof clause
signature: Show the claim context through the setup clause; cut to the proving asset on the operative noun or verb; remain there through the sentence end.

name: Native sound identifies the result
signature: Play the action source; let the result sound begin just before the cut; reveal the visible result when that sound becomes recognizable.

name: Object shape changes worlds
signature: Align the dominant silhouette in both assets; close asset A on the shape; hard-cut to the homologous shape in asset B; then reveal its context.

name: Light-value bridge
signature: End asset A on a large coherent light or dark region; cut to asset B with the subject emerging from the same luma mass; hold the new subject.

name: Before and after share one anchor
signature: Frame the unchanged anchor in state A; cut to state B with position and scale locked; reveal only the meaningful changed property.

name: Reaction precedes its cause
signature: Open on a human or system reaction; let the causal sound trail; cut back to the source action; stop once the causal connection is understood.

name: Setup object becomes consequence object
signature: Track a setup object toward frame edge; cut on contact to a different object receiving the same vector; widen just enough to show the consequence relation.

name: Texture clue to contextual wide
signature: Begin on a distinctive texture; cut wide with that texture held at the same screen position; let the rest of the environment explain it.

name: Object fragment names the location
signature: Isolate one recognizable object fragment; pull focus away from it or cut to a wide where it remains foreground; establish the place behind it.

name: Macro action continues wide
signature: Show a small action at macro scale; cut on the motion to the wide view of the same action; preserve direction and temporal continuity.

name: Continuous optical pullback
signature: Lock the detail anchor; pull back through medium context into the full wide without a cut; stop as soon as the spatial relation is clear.

name: Wide ambience arrives inside the detail
signature: Hold the detail shot; introduce the wide environment sound; let the detail respond if possible; cut wide on the ambience peak.

name: Detail silhouette matches aerial form
signature: Close on a bounded detail shape; cut to an aerial feature with the same silhouette; widen or drift only enough to reveal the scale jump.

name: Foreground clears the wide
signature: Start tight behind a moving foreground object; track its exit; use maximum occlusion to reveal the wide location beyond.

name: Misread scale corrected by context
signature: Hold a detail long enough to invite a scale assumption; reveal a stable reference object; pull wide once to overturn that assumption.

name: Map resolves into aerial
signature: Locate one point on a simple map; approach it; replace the map texture with matching aerial imagery while keeping orientation stable; settle on the site.

name: Ground horizon rises to aerial context
signature: Begin at human eye level; crane or cut upward along a stable landmark; reveal the larger terrain once the landmark becomes a map-like anchor.

name: Aerial descent finds the subject
signature: Open on broad aerial context; descend toward a pre-identified landmark; stop at an oriented medium-wide where the subject can be located.

name: Route trace earns the move
signature: Show origin and destination in one aerial field; animate one path from origin; move the camera only as the trace advances; stop at the destination.

name: Landmark isolate then pullback
signature: Begin on the landmark at medium scale; suppress surrounding contrast; restore the full aerial context while pulling back and keeping the landmark fixed.

name: Same geography changes time state
signature: Lock an aerial viewpoint; transform day to night, dry to flood, or past to present; preserve roads and contours so the changed state reads spatially.

name: Top-down map becomes oblique world
signature: Start orthographic over the site; pitch the camera into an oblique view while keeping north or a declared orientation key; reveal elevation and access.

name: Human marker hands off to landscape scale
signature: Establish a person or vehicle at a known coordinate; pull rapidly but smoothly to the landscape scale; keep the marker visible until scale is understood.

name: Wide-medium-detail corroboration
signature: Establish the whole event; cut to the responsible action; cut to the decisive physical detail; hold the detail as verification.

name: Claim, source, consequence
signature: Show the claimed condition; reveal the primary source or artifact; finish on a visible real-world consequence rather than another claim.

name: Person, tool, output
signature: Begin with the operator; cut on their gesture to the tool in use; cut on tool action to the output; keep vectors coherent.

name: Location, process, result
signature: Orient the location; enter the local process; exit to the result in the same geographic direction; keep one landmark persistent and hold the result.

name: Detail, medium, wide consequence
signature: Start with a revealing detail; widen to the actor or mechanism; finish wide on the broader consequence, preserving the detail as an anchor when possible.

name: Two proofs form one synthesis
signature: Present proof A and proof B as separate full frames; on the third beat, place both in a restrained shared composition around one synthesis subject.

name: Setup, action, aftermath
signature: Show the untouched setup; cut at action onset; skip directly to the stable aftermath; make the changed state the final focal point.

name: Observation, measurement, lived effect
signature: Open with an observable phenomenon; cut to its measurement; finish on how that measured change affects a person or environment.

name: Clause collapses to the operative word
signature: Show a short central phrase; fade the supporting words only after it is read; keep the operative serif word fixed as the sole final focus.

name: Background yields to one word
signature: Establish the subject image; lower only its local contrast; reveal one keyword at the subject-adjacent focal point; restore the image after reading.

name: Tracked word names the moving subject
signature: Place one keyword beside the subject; maintain a restrained positional relationship through a single motion; remove the word before the next beat.

name: Semantic underline measures the exact term
signature: Reveal one keyword; draw a single underline only beneath its meaningful span; stop the line at the final letter and hold without extra marks.

name: Antonym replacement changes the reading
signature: Hold the first keyword in a stable sentence frame; replace it in-place with its semantic opposite; keep all surrounding composition unchanged.

name: Word scale follows real magnitude
signature: Anchor a keyword to a measured object or phenomenon; change the word scale only as the represented magnitude changes; stop at the final measured state.

name: Cause word hands off to effect word
signature: Reveal the cause word near its source; move attention through the visible action; replace it with the effect word at the consequence location.

name: Quotation resolves to its key word
signature: Show a brief quotation fragment; highlight no more than one term; let all other words recede, leaving the selected word over its evidence image.

name: Context first, value second
signature: Show the measured subject and unit context; reveal the value only after the viewer knows what is being counted; hold subject and value together.

name: Objects accumulate into a numeral
signature: Add visible countable units in meaningful steps; after the last unit arrives, resolve the total as one serif numeral; stop all motion.

name: Measure fills, then number locks
signature: Grow one legitimate bar, gauge, or distance measure from zero to the observed endpoint; place the final value only when movement stops.

name: Before-after delta revealed last
signature: Show the baseline value beside its state; transform the state; replace with the new value; reveal the delta only after both endpoints are understood.

name: Physical scale brackets the statistic
signature: Position the measured subject between two real reference objects; introduce the value after the scale relation reads; retain only one comparison cue.

name: Meaningful accumulation count-up
signature: Count upward in coarse semantic steps synchronized to visible accumulation; slow before the final value; land exactly when the real process completes.

name: Estimate resolves to an uncertainty range
signature: Begin with evidence rather than a precise number; reveal a bounded range; narrow or widen it once as the stated uncertainty changes.

name: Denominator changes the interpretation
signature: Present the headline count; reveal the denominator or comparison base; recompose both as a rate or proportion and hold the corrected reading.

name: Full source to exact crop
signature: Show the complete page or screenshot for orientation; push once to the relevant region; stop with enough surrounding context to verify its location.

name: One region remains while the rest dims
signature: Hold the full source; dim nonessential regions uniformly; keep one proof region at normal contrast; restore the whole source before exit.

name: Scroll, stop, read
signature: Begin high enough to establish the source; scroll at one controlled speed; decelerate at the target passage; remain completely still for reading.

name: Pointer arrives only after orientation
signature: Display the full interface first; move one pointer along a short intentional route; stop on the proof control or datum; remove the pointer after the action.

name: Source state toggles in place
signature: Lock the interface frame; show state A; perform one authentic interaction; reveal state B with changed fields aligned to their previous positions.

name: Magnifier verifies, then withdraws
signature: Establish the whole source; move one magnifier to a single target; enlarge the proof region inside it; withdraw to restore source context.

name: Perspective page squares to evidence
signature: Introduce the source at a modest spatial angle as an object; rotate it front-facing at the target clause; hold the legible evidence flat.

name: Two regions in causal reading order
signature: Orient the full source; focus region one; return briefly to the whole; focus region two; finish with both locations understood but only one active cue at a time.

name: Foreground card uncovers context card
signature: Hold a foreground card over part of a context card; move the foreground once along depth and aside; reveal the relationship on the back plane.

name: Lateral travel through staggered evidence
signature: Arrange evidence on three depth planes; travel laterally so foreground occlusion guides the order; settle with the final card unobstructed.

name: Flat cards assemble into a depth stack
signature: Introduce two to four cards in reading order; move each to a distinct depth; align their shared anchor into one coherent spatial stack.

name: Front card lifts to expose dependency
signature: Establish a stack as one object; lift only the front card; reveal the linked evidence directly beneath; return or exit through that dependency.

name: Shallow orbit reveals hidden card relation
signature: Begin front-on; orbit a limited angle around the stack; let parallax expose one previously hidden relationship; stop before the layout becomes decorative.

name: Focus rack crosses depth planes
signature: Hold camera position; focus the foreground evidence, then the middle connection, then the background conclusion; use no simultaneous moving cards.

name: Causal action propagates card to card
signature: Trigger a visible state on the first card; pass one signal through the depth stack; change each downstream card only after the prior event completes.

name: Card corridor collapses into destination
signature: Travel through a short corridor of evidence planes; align their apertures; collapse them into the destination scene at the final plane.

name: Subject lock, background push
signature: Separate subject from background; keep the subject scale nearly fixed; push the background to reveal spatial context; settle both layers naturally.

name: Foreground parallax reveals hidden context
signature: Move one foreground matte across a small arc; expose a previously hidden background fact; stop when the fact and subject share the frame.

name: Shallow arc around a still subject
signature: Build foreground, subject, and background planes; arc the camera modestly around the subject; use occlusion changes to explain relative placement.

name: Atmospheric depth clears toward the subject
signature: Begin with distance haze separating planes; clear the haze from the focal subject outward; reveal depth without moving the still itself.

name: Detail crop pulls through reconstructed depth
signature: Start on a meaningful detail; pull back across separated planes; preserve the detail anchor until the full scene relationship is visible.

name: Foreground subject peels from archival image
signature: Hold the original photograph intact; separate the foreground subject just enough to expose archival context behind; restore the original frame before exit.

name: Cast shadow establishes the subject plane
signature: Reveal a separated subject first; introduce a physically coherent cast shadow onto the background plane; move camera once to confirm their spatial relation.

name: Enter a doorway inside the photograph
signature: Reconstruct depth around a real doorway or aperture; approach it through foreground and subject planes; cross into the destination represented beyond it.

name: Central card becomes the next scene
signature: Establish a small set of source cards; select the central destination card; expand it while preserving its focal anchor until it fills the frame.

name: Tiles reassemble into one coherent image
signature: Show three or four rectilinear source tiles; move them into their true spatial positions; remove seams only after the complete destination is recognizable.

name: Interface window opens into its subject
signature: Orient the interface or document; approach one authentic media window; cross its border at full scale into the represented world.

name: Page turns edge-on to reveal destination
signature: Treat one page or card as a physical plane; rotate it edge-on; let the destination appear on the far side; square the destination to camera.

name: Object aperture carries the cut
signature: Find a genuine circular or bounded aperture in the source; center the destination through it; pass through the aperture and let its edge leave frame.

name: Foreground wipe replaces the collage world
signature: Move a real foreground object across the collage; hide the asset swap at full occlusion; clear into the coherent destination scene.

name: Rectilinear panels align into a passage
signature: Arrange vertical and horizontal panels from separate sources; shift them into one aligned opening; enter only after the passage reads as continuous space.

name: Evidence planes form a traversable corridor
signature: Pull scattered evidence cards into depth order; fly through them as each contributes one clue; exit the last plane into the resolved world.

name: Contrast isolate and restore
signature: Establish the complete system; reduce surrounding contrast; keep one component unchanged; explain its action; restore the whole at the same framing.

name: Push to part, pull to consequence
signature: Orient the whole; approach one component without changing object orientation; show its operation; pull back to reveal the whole-system consequence.

name: Ghosted whole preserves orientation
signature: Show the full system; ghost nonselected parts rather than removing them; operate the selected component; return all parts to normal opacity.

name: Component steps out and returns
signature: Establish the assembly; translate one component along a real removal axis; inspect its interface; replace it and resume the full system.

name: Local cutaway window
signature: Hold the whole object intact; open one bounded cutaway only over the selected component; show its action; close the window to restore the exterior.

name: Orientation lock before isolation
signature: Rotate the whole once to establish front, side, and selected face; stop on a declared orientation; isolate the part without further camera drift; reintegrate.

name: Effect trace returns to the source part
signature: Start with the full-system effect; trace backward to the responsible component; show the component action; trace forward and restore the whole effect.

name: One of many, then systemic repetition
signature: Show the complete repeated system; isolate one representative unit; demonstrate its operation; pull back as the same state propagates to its peers.

name: Human action enters the system hierarchy
signature: Orient a person and complete system; follow one human input into the selected component; continue through its downstream effect; return to human-scale consequence.

name: Nested system dive and reassembly
signature: Begin with the hero whole; enter through two nested component levels; operate the deepest mechanism; reverse the exact spatial path as every level reassembles.

name: Outer shell fades for one interior
signature: Establish the intact object; lower only the shell opacity; keep the selected interior solid; demonstrate it; restore the shell without changing view.

name: Real lid or panel opens
signature: Show the closed object; hinge or slide the authentic access panel; reveal the internal component; close the same panel after the explanation.

name: Layer stack separates on one axis
signature: Orient the intact stack; separate layers along their real assembly axis in hierarchy order; inspect one interface; compress back to intact.

name: Radial components expose the core
signature: Start intact; move only the surrounding radial components outward along their mounts; reveal and operate the core; return the ring around it.

name: Section plane travels through the object
signature: Introduce a single sectional plane at the exterior; sweep it through the object; pause at the critical interior relation; remove the plane and restore exterior.

name: X-ray handoff to physical interior
signature: Crossfade the intact exterior to an aligned x-ray view; select one interior form; transition that form into a solid cutaway model for explanation.

name: Assembly runs backward into inspection
signature: Open on separated parts with clear hierarchy; assemble them in causal order; stop before the final shell; inspect the internal interface; complete the assembly.

name: Access panels open in service order
signature: Establish the intact system; open sequential service panels according to real access order; expose the target; reverse the closure sequence on exit.

name: Exploded orbit preserves every connector
signature: Separate the full 3D assembly while connector paths remain visible; orbit once around the critical hierarchy; rejoin parts along those paths into the hero whole.

name: Building envelope peels to occupied mechanism
signature: Orient the full building or environment; remove envelope layers from outside inward; reveal people and mechanism operating together; restore the exterior at scale.

name: Three-stage trigger chain
signature: Orient input, transmission component, and output; fire the input; animate transmission only after contact; change the output last and hold its consequence.

name: Pulse traverses one channel
signature: Locate the channel origin; launch one pulse; follow it without overtaking; reveal the output state exactly when the pulse arrives.

name: Material flow exposes a bottleneck
signature: Start material at the input; trace its motion through two stages; visibly slow and accumulate at the bottleneck; release into the measured output.

name: Lever transfers motion through gears
signature: Show force applied to the lever; rotate each connected gear only after tooth contact; move the final actuator; pull back to show the produced result.

name: Signal branches and reconverges
signature: Trigger one signal; split it at a real branch; follow both routes with staggered timing; reconverge them at the component that produces the output.

name: Feedback changes the original input
signature: Run input through transmission to output; route a visible return signal from output; modify the input state only when feedback arrives; show the stabilized loop.

name: Threshold accumulation triggers a state
signature: Add discrete input increments; show the stored quantity rising; keep output unchanged below threshold; trigger one clear output transformation at crossing.

name: Parallel inputs converge on one result
signature: Orient two independent inputs; activate them at different moments; trace both to a shared component; reveal output only after both conditions are satisfied.

name: Macro cause dives micro, returns macro
signature: Show the large-scale trigger; enter the affected material or subsystem; animate the microscopic transmission; pull back to the visible macroscopic consequence.

name: Failure cascade arrested at one component
signature: Trigger a multi-component failure in correct causal order; let the cascade approach a critical output; activate one intervention; reverse or halt downstream changes and show recovery.

name: Origin-to-destination route
signature: Orient the full route; mark the origin; trace one continuous path; stop at the destination; hold origin and destination relationship.

name: One branch selected from alternatives
signature: Show the shared origin and available branches; travel to the decision point; emphasize one criterion; continue only on the selected branch.

name: Bottleneck slows the trace
signature: Advance a trace at stable speed; decelerate at the bottleneck; show the accumulating queue or pressure; resume only after the constraint changes.

name: Reverse trace finds the source
signature: Open on the visible result; trace backward along the route; pause at each causal junction; finish on the originating input or decision.

name: Timeline path makes a gap visible
signature: Orient start and end on a timeline; reveal known events in order; leave one deliberate spatial gap; stop the trace at that missing interval.

name: Network hops expose dependency order
signature: Locate source and destination nodes; activate one connection at a time; keep prior nodes visible but quiet; reveal the dependency chain on arrival.

name: Map trace becomes physical travel
signature: Trace the route on a map; align a moving marker with a real vehicle or subject; transition into physical footage while preserving route direction; arrive in-world.

name: Multi-floor path through a building
signature: Orient the building exterior; enter the correct floor; trace through rooms and vertical circulation; exit at the destination while preserving floor context.

name: Decision branch shows downstream cost
signature: Trace to a fork; follow option A briefly to its consequence; reset to the same fork; follow option B; end with both outcomes spatially related.

name: Route crosses map, section, and lived world
signature: Begin on geographic overview; hand the same path into a sectional mechanism view; continue it into human-scale footage; preserve the moving anchor through every representation.

name: Empty system becomes populated
signature: Lock the system framing; introduce contents in real entry order; show the final populated operating state; preserve object orientation throughout.

name: Closed system opens and works
signature: Establish the closed state; perform the authentic opening action; reveal the newly available operation; return to the same exterior anchor.

name: Dry-to-wet propagation
signature: Hold one environment or material; introduce liquid at its source; let the wet boundary propagate physically; reveal the functional consequence at saturation.

name: Intact exterior becomes cutaway state
signature: Begin with the intact object; transform only a bounded exterior region to cutaway; operate the interior; restore intact state at the same camera position.

name: Stalled mechanism restarts
signature: Show the system halted with a visible constraint; remove or correct that constraint; start components in causal order; hold the stable operating state.

name: Seasonal state alters operation
signature: Lock geography and structures; transform one environmental season or condition; update only the mechanisms affected by that change; compare the new operation.

name: Contaminated flow becomes clean
signature: Trace contaminated input into the process; perform each treatment state in order; reveal clean output; keep a before sample visible until comparison resolves.

name: Chaotic set organizes by rule
signature: Begin with a genuinely unordered set; introduce one sorting or alignment rule; move each item only when classified; reveal the ordered functional whole.

name: Intervention transforms problem to solution
signature: Establish problem state and its symptom; enter the intervention at the causal point; propagate changes through the system; pull back to the solved whole.

name: Three-state reversible cycle
signature: Orient the stable system; transform A to B through visible mechanism; continue B to C; reverse the causal route back to A without hiding intermediate states.

name: Synchronized start, divergent finish
signature: Align both assets at the same starting state; begin the shared action together; let only the causal difference diverge; freeze on the two outcomes.

name: Same action, different result
signature: Frame both subjects at matched scale; trigger the same action simultaneously; hold the resulting difference while all irrelevant motion stops.

name: Physical size on a shared baseline
signature: Place both subjects against one legitimate scale baseline; reveal the smaller first, then the larger; hold both with one measurement cue.

name: Locked before-after divider
signature: Align before and after images perfectly; move one vertical divider once to expose the changed regions; stop at a frame showing both states clearly.

name: One criterion at a time
signature: Hold both assets; introduce criterion one and isolate its difference; clear it; introduce criterion two; finish on the criterion that changes the conclusion.

name: Parallel timelines reveal delay
signature: Start two timelines at the same event; advance them together; pause one when it diverges; keep the other moving to expose the time difference.

name: Matched process, different bottleneck
signature: Run the same process on both sides; trace each to its distinct bottleneck; hold there; resume to show how the constraint changes output.

name: Blind outcome, criterion reveal
signature: Show two outcomes without labels; allow a neutral first read; reveal the single comparison criterion; recompose attention to the evidence that determines the result.

name: Claim to counterexample
signature: Establish claim A with its strongest supporting image; cut to one direct counterexample on the rebuttal clause; hold the contradictory property.

name: Conventional view yields to mechanism
signature: Show the familiar surface explanation; maintain framing while a cutaway or causal layer appears; let the hidden mechanism replace the first reading.

name: Same footage, new evidence frame
signature: Play one ambiguous shot; freeze at the relevant moment; reveal the missing context or measurement; replay the moment under the corrected interpretation.

name: Apparent cause becomes effect
signature: Present the common causal direction; pause at the presumed link; reverse the trace using evidence; finish with the corrected direction held.

name: Quotation challenged by measured result
signature: Show the brief quoted position; cut to the measurement method; reveal the result; retain only the quoted keyword needed for contrast.

name: Surface symptom opens to hidden driver
signature: Establish the visible symptom; enter or peel beneath it; locate and operate the hidden driver; return to the same symptom as it changes.

name: Certainty widens into a range
signature: Present a precise conventional value; introduce the omitted variability; transform the point value into a bounded range; hold the uncertainty as the corrected claim.

name: Opposing readings resolve into synthesis
signature: Establish thesis and antithesis as full, legible states; reveal the condition under which each holds; recompose both into a third synthesis frame.

name: Repair in the same locked shot
signature: Hold problem state in a fixed frame; perform one visible corrective action; let the system settle into the solution without replacing the shot.

name: Matched problem-solution cut
signature: Establish the problem around a stable anchor; hard-cut to the solved state with that anchor unchanged; hold only the corrected property.

name: Obstruction removed, flow restored
signature: Trace flow until it stops at the obstruction; remove the obstruction visibly; resume the same trace through to the output.

name: Clutter reduces to the needed control
signature: Show an overloaded interface or system; group and remove irrelevant elements by function; preserve the essential control; demonstrate the simplified operation.

name: Failure dip, solution pickup
signature: Let the failed action land without a hit; dip the music; reveal the intervention; restore the music as the same action succeeds.

name: Struggle, tool, resolved action
signature: Show a person failing at one action; cut on their reach to the correct tool; complete the action with the tool; hold the changed outcome.

name: Detour collapses to direct route
signature: Trace the costly problem route; mark its delay; introduce the solution connection; reroute the same traveler through the shorter path.

name: System redesign resolves multiple symptoms
signature: Establish several symptoms as effects of one layout; transform the mechanism at the root; propagate improvements outward; pull back to the stable redesigned whole.

name: Circle to eye or aperture
signature: Close the outgoing shot on one circular subject; cut at matched center and scale to an eye, lens, or aperture; reveal the incoming context outward.

name: Hand-held rectangle to screen
signature: Move a rectangular object toward a stable frame position; cut when its edges align with an incoming screen or window; continue into the new content.

name: Horizon line to structural edge
signature: End on a strong horizon or shelf line; cut to an architectural or object edge at the same height; let the new subject emerge from that edge.

name: Rotating wheel to rotating mechanism
signature: Match center, radius, and angular direction between two rotating objects; cut at a shared spoke angle; continue rotation before revealing the second scale.

name: Arch silhouette to doorway
signature: Fill the frame with an outgoing arch or curved void; cut to a homologous doorway; travel through the incoming opening to establish place.

name: Vertical object to structural pillar
signature: Raise or reveal a slender outgoing object; cut when it occupies the intended coordinate to an incoming pillar, tree, or tower; pull wide from the match.

name: Center anchor handoff
signature: End with one outgoing focal subject centered; cut to the next priority at the same coordinate and similar scale; delay all secondary motion until the eye lands.

name: Eyeline places the incoming subject
signature: Show the outgoing subject looking toward one screen position; cut to the incoming object exactly there; hold before reframing.

name: Upper-frame detail stays upper-frame
signature: Finish on a meaningful detail in the upper safe region; cut to the next detail at the same coordinate; then reveal its new context downward.

name: Detail-scale continuity across worlds
signature: End on a close detail; match the incoming focal point at equal apparent scale; allow the incoming camera to widen only after recognition.

name: Moving anchor crosses the cut point
signature: Track an outgoing focal anchor toward a chosen coordinate; cut exactly as it reaches that coordinate; continue its vector with the incoming anchor.

name: Keyword lands on its physical referent
signature: End with one central keyword; cut to a physical object occupying the same word mass and coordinate; let the word disappear as the object action begins.

name: Pan vector carries the boundary
signature: Accelerate into one motivated pan; cut while the frame is motion-blurred; enter the new shot with the same vector; decelerate onto the subject.

name: Passing person hides the cut
signature: Let a person cross close to the lens; cut at full-body occlusion; continue their screen direction as the new environment clears.

name: Door close opens another place
signature: Track a real door or panel closing over the frame; cut at full closure; reverse the same physical action to open on the destination.

name: Shadow sweep changes the scene
signature: Use a coherent cast shadow to cross the outgoing subject; replace the scene only inside full darkness; let the shadow continue off the incoming subject.

name: Foreground object passes the lens
signature: Move a relevant object directly across the camera; hide the cut at maximum coverage; reveal a matched object action in the destination.

name: Enter darkness, exit another world
signature: Approach a real tunnel, aperture, or unlit cavity; cross into full darkness; preserve motion and ambience; emerge from a homologous opening in the next world.

name: Incoming voice precedes the picture
signature: Keep the outgoing image while the next speaker or narration clause begins; cut picture on the phrase that identifies the destination; retain the new voice.

name: Destination ambience arrives first
signature: Hold the outgoing subject; fade in one unmistakable destination ambience; allow a reaction or pause; cut to its visual source without an added hit.

name: Outgoing line trails into reaction
signature: Cut from the speaker or source to the listener or consequence before the line ends; let the final words complete over the incoming image.

name: Mechanism sound trails into the result
signature: Cut picture from the operating mechanism to its output; carry the authentic mechanism sound through the cut; let it decay when the result stabilizes.

name: Music motif previews the next image
signature: Introduce a distinct musical figure under the outgoing shot; cut picture when the motif resolves; associate the incoming subject with that motif.

name: Room tone masks a temporal jump
signature: Hold continuous room or environmental tone; cut between two times or angles on a stable focal anchor; reveal the temporal change through picture only.

name: Separated parts return to the whole
signature: Recall the isolated parts in their learned positions; move them back along authentic assembly paths; pull back only after the complete whole operates.

name: Opening image returns with new understanding
signature: Match the opening hero frame; reveal the mechanism or relationship now understood inside that same composition; hold without adding a new claim.

name: Causal path reverses into system view
signature: Begin on the final output; trace backward through every explained component; collapse the trace; reveal all components operating together in the whole.

name: Multiple viewpoints converge in 3D
signature: Bring previously seen detail, section, and wide views into spatial alignment; fuse them into one oriented 3D hero system; complete one final operating action.

name: Learned sequence, compressed
signature: Replay three to five established visuals in the exact learned order; shorten each recognition beat; stop on one synthesis frame rather than another recap image.

name: Recap tiles assemble a hierarchy
signature: Bring back each established visual as one restrained tile; place it into its learned system position; finish on the complete hierarchy with all motion stopped.

name: Callback motif travels through every stage
signature: Reintroduce the original visual or audio motif; carry it through each learned stage as a persistent anchor; let its final form trigger the synthesis image.

name: World resolves around one concluding line
signature: Let the final environment finish its physical action; reveal one central or diegetically placed concluding line; hold the world and line through the music cadence.

name: Pullback discovers the CTA object in-world
signature: Begin on the resolved subject; pull back to reveal a real screen, plaque, book, tool, or doorway carrying the next action; stop before it becomes a generic card.

name: Last mechanism action closes the film
signature: Complete one final causally earned action in the hero world; let its native sound and music cadence resolve together; hold the stable result, then cut cleanly to black.
